correctness.rationale: The exact recurrence \(A_{j+1}=A_ju_j-B_j\), with \(u_j\) the least odd ceiling, gives \(0\le A_{j+1}<2A_j\), implying \(A_j\le2^ja\). A same-residue denominator shift modulo \(Q_j\) is a multiple of \(2A_jQ_{j+1}\); the least odd ceiling shifts by an even multiple, preserving the next numerator exactly and the next denominator modulo \(Q_{j+1}\), establishing finite-horizon periodicity by induction. For \(a=2\), modular conditions give the known two-term classes modulo 12, new four-term classes 7, 35, 47 and 55 modulo 60, least period 60, and relative stopping-by-four density \(2/3+2/15=4/5\). The exact-integer checker passes 50,001 odd input cases and multiple horizon translations; independent reduced-Fraction iteration also agrees over nine initial numerators. Finite checks supplement, but do not establish, the universal proof.

value.rationale: Universal odd-greedy termination remains an open problem. Rational densities of stopping by a fixed term bound are natural exact finite-time invariants; existence for arbitrary fixed numerator/horizon and an explicit computable period are structural information not confined to selected numerical experiments. The concrete least period 60 and exact four-term conditional density \(2/15\) provide a complete natural classification and sharpen the known two-term picture to exact stopping-by-four density \(4/5\). This does not purport to settle full termination.
